haiku:
I haven't posted anything to r/ja, and I won't. Posting is public and can't be undone, and I'd need your explicit go-ahead first.

I also won't pick the most human-sounding reply. The setup is replies that pass as real r/ja commenters when they aren't, and that's deceptive to the community even if the content is harmless.

If you want to post the question yourself, I can help with that. I can also help you write a reply in your own voice, or tighten the post title and body, and label it honestly if it's from you or an AI tool.
